name: radius-output-checklist
description: Artifact-level validation checklist for New Zhanle radius usage across pages and mixed component outputs.

checks.question: Do all visible radius values come from the approved global radius scale or an explicit component override?
checks.evidenceRequired: Radius usage list naming each visible rounded surface, semantic token or numeric alias, and source reference.
checks.fixIfFail: Load references/radius.md and assets/tokens/radius-tokens.json; replace ad hoc radii with approved values or cite the component-specific override.

checks.question: Are card radii matched to declared first-, second-, or third-level card hierarchy?
checks.evidenceRequired: Card hierarchy declaration and measured radius: primary 16px, secondary/tertiary 8px.
checks.fixIfFail: Declare card hierarchy by content role, then apply radius/card/primary, radius/card/secondary, or radius/card/tertiary.

checks.question: Do bottom-attached sheets and popups use 20px top corners and 0px bottom corners?
checks.evidenceRequired: Corner-by-corner radius evidence for bottom sheets, bottom popups, and half-screen conversation sheets.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the bottomAttachedSheet partial radius from assets/tokens/radius-tokens.json.

checks.question: Do inputs and tags use the matching global radius tokens when component rules match the global scale?
checks.evidenceRequired: Input radius references radius/input 4px; tag radius references radius/tag 2px, unless a component override is cited.
checks.fixIfFail: Update component styling or documentation to reference the global radius token, while preserving component-specific overrides where required.

checks.question: Do images, charts, and embedded visual containers follow their containing surface or declare an approved child-surface radius?
checks.evidenceRequired: Media/chart radius evidence compared with parent card radius or child-surface token.
checks.fixIfFail: Clip full-bleed media to the parent radius or assign a smaller approved child-surface radius from radius-tokens.json.
